newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Overseas in HK$1.5 bln share issue.
newsitem.headline: China Overseas in HK$1.5 bln share issue.

text.p: China Overseas Land and Investment Ltd said on Thursday its controlling shareholder, China Overseas Holdings Ltd, has placed 392 million existing shares it held at HK$3.875 per share.

The parent also agreed to subscribe for the same amount of new shares at the same price for an aggregate HK$1.5 billion, Sam Kwok, director and general manager of finance of China Overseas Land, told Reuters.
Proceeds will be used to finance China Overseas Land's investment in toll road and toll bridge projects in China and for its investment in a Beijing low-cost housing project, Kwok said.
The placement is handled by ING Baring, he said. The placed shares amount to about 10 percent of the company's existing share capital.
On completion of the placement and issue, shareholding of China Overseas Holdings in the company will be diluted to 63 percent from 68 percent, Kwok said.
Trading in shares of China Overseas Land was suspended on Thursday pending an announcement. Its shares ended at HK$4.05 on Wednesday.
